story.overview:
As a Slack user, I want to upload files (PDFs, images, CSVs, etc.) in my messages to Orion, so that Claude can read and analyze the file contents as part of my request.
This story enables file ingestion by: 1. Detecting files in Slack message events 2. Downloading files via Slack API 3. Uploading to Anthropic Files API (reusing Story 6.5 client) 4. Including as document blocks with Citations support (pairs with Story 8.1)

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Detect `files` array in Slack `message` events (both DM and channel)
Support multiple files in a single message (process all)
Log file metadata (name, type, size) to Langfuse for observability
Download file content via Slack API using `url_private_download`
Use bot token for authentication (`Authorization: Bearer ${SLACK_BOT_TOKEN}`)
Handle download failures gracefully (log error, inform user, continue without file)
Respect file size limits (max 100MB per file)
Upload downloaded file to Anthropic Files API
Reuse existing `FilesApiClient` from `src/files/api-client.ts` (Story 6.5)
Track upload success/failure in Langfuse
Create document block with `file_id` reference for each uploaded file
Enable `citations: { enabled: true }` on document blocks (pairs with Story 8.1)
Include document blocks in messages array before calling agent loop
Handle unsupported file types gracefully (inform user, skip file)
PDF files (`.pdf`) - max 100MB
Images (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp`) - max 20MB
CSV files (`.csv`) - max 100MB
Text files (`.txt`, `.md`, `.json`, `.xml`, `.yaml`, `.yml`) - max 100MB
Reject unsupported formats with helpful message listing supported types
File too large: Inform user of size limit
Download failed: Log error, inform user, continue processing text message
Upload failed: Log error, inform user, continue processing text message
Unsupported type: Inform user of supported types
Track file ingestion metrics in Langfuse (count, types, sizes, success rate)
Include file metadata in trace for debugging

dependencies.dependency: Files API Client - provides download infrastructure and uploadBuffer()
Files API Slack Integration - provides upload to Slack
Citations API - enables document citations (forward compatible)

note.item: ESM imports: Always use `.js` extension - `import { x } from './module.js'`
Tool errors: Never throw, return `ToolResult<T>` with success/error
Logging: Include `traceId` in every log entry
Config: Import order matters - `instrumentation.ts` first in `index.ts`
`src/files/api-client.ts` - Files API client from Story 6.5 with uploadBuffer() method
Expired Slack URL: Slack file URLs can expire. If download fails with 404/403, inform user "File no longer available"
Zero-byte file: Skip files with `size === 0`, log warning, inform user
MIME/Extension mismatch: Trust Slack's `mimetype` field over file extension for validation
Story 8.1 not ready: If Citations (Story 8.1) is not yet implemented, set `citations: { enabled: true }` anyway - it's forward compatible

relevant-sections.section: Story 8.3 implements FR51 (Slack File Ingestion) as part of Epic 8's focus on Anthropic API Enhancements. The flow is: Slack file upload -> Orion detects files array -> Download via Slack API -> Upload to Anthropic Files API -> Include as document block with Citations support.

Location: `src/files/api-client.ts`. Operations: getFile(), getFileMetadata(), uploadBuffer(). Supported formats: xlsx, pdf, docx, pptx, png, jpg, svg, csv, json, txt. Max file size: 100MB per file. Retention: 7 days from generation.

Files API integration established in Epic 6 Stories 6.5-6.6. FilesApiClient provides uploadBuffer(buffer, filename, mimeType, traceId) for uploading files to Anthropic. This story reuses this existing infrastructure for ingestion.

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Every tool handler MUST wrap its entire body in try/catch. Return `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, error }`. Never throw from tool handlers.
Always use `.js` extension on relative imports: `import { handler } from './handler.js'`
Every log entry should include: traceId, spanName, slackThreadTs (if in Slack context). Levels: ERROR (user-impacting), WARN (degraded), INFO (key events), DEBUG (dev only).
Files: `kebab-case.ts` (enforced by ESLint). Tests: `kebab-case.test.ts` (co-located with source). Classes/Interfaces: PascalCase. Functions/Variables: camelCase.
Entry points: import config directly. Utilities: receive values as parameters. NEVER: import config at module level in shared utilities.

implementation-guidance.phase: Start with Task 1: Extend Slack types and add file detection in both handlers. This is the foundation for all subsequent work. Log file metadata to Langfuse early to verify detection works.
Task 2: Create the Slack file download service. Test with various file types and sizes. Handle edge cases (expired URLs, zero-byte files, size limits) early.
Task 3: Wire up download to existing FilesApiClient.uploadBuffer(). The upload infrastructure already exists - this is orchestration code only.
Task 4: Build document blocks with citations enabled. Format validation and user-friendly error messages for unsupported types.
Task 5: Modify agent loop to accept and include document blocks. Prepend to first user message content array per Anthropic requirements.
Task 6: Comprehensive testing. Unit tests should cover 79 test cases. Manual E2E test with actual Slack file uploads.
